program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const mass = inputs.mass; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const height = Math.max(0, launchSpeed * time - 0.5 * gravity * time * t); const velocity = launchSpeed - gravity * time; const acceleration = -gravity; const force = mass * gravity; let motionState = "Rising"; if (time === 0) motionState = "Ready to toss"; else if (Math.abs(velocity) < 0.05) motionState = "At the top"; else if (velocity < 0) motionState = time > 2 * apexTime ? "Back at launch height" : "Falling"; const objects = []; objects.push(sdk.panel({ x: 20, y: 35, w: 290, h: 360, title: "The Motion", state: motionState })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.y", { x: 70, y: 350, length: 260, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, label: "Height", unit: "m" })); const ballY = 350 - (height / 2.2) * 260; objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", 160, ballY, 28, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: 160, y: ballY }, { value: velocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: 195, y: ballY }, { value: acceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "a", role: "prediction" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(215, ballY - 20, ["v: " + sdk.format(velocity, 2) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(acceleration, 1) + " m/s^2", "Fg: " + sdk.format(force, 1) + " N"], { id: "callout.toss" })); const vtPoints = sdk.sample((t) => launchSpeed - gravity * t, 0, Math.min(time, 2 * apexTime), 20); objects.push(sdk.panel({ x: 330, y: 35, w: 290, h: 360, title: "Velocity over Time", state: "v = u - gt" })); objects.push(sdk.plot("plot.vt", { x: 350, y: 70, w: 250, h: 280, axes: { x: { label: "Time", min: 0, max: 1.8, unit: "s" }, y: { label: "Velocity", min: -5.5, max: 5.5, unit: "m/s" } }, series: [{ label: "v(t)", kind: "line", points: vtPoints.map(p => ({ x: p[0], y: p[1] })) }] })); objects.push(sdk.text("plot.vt.note", 360, 370, "Slope a = -g", { role: "muted" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects: objects, readouts: [{ id: "velocity", value: velocity }, { id: "acceleration", value: acceleration }, { id: "force", value: force }, { id: "motionState", value: motionState }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: launchSpeed, gravity: gravity, mass: mass, apexTime: apexTime, apexHeight: apexHeight, height: height, velocity: velocity, acceleration: acceleration, force: force } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero, but acceleration remains -g and gravitational force equals mg.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side views show a tossed ball on a height ruler with vectors and callouts, alongside a velocity-time graph.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare readings near the top.
